heading: Today
text: Some patchy fog giving way to morning sun, then clouds increasing.  Showers or a stray thunderstorm developing in the St. Lawrence Valley this morning, spreading into the Adirondacks, then just scattered east from Rt. 4 north this afternoon. Partly sunny south.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Light winds, becoming south to southwest near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: A few localized evening showers or a thunderstorm north giving way to partial clearing. Partly cloudy south.  Lows in the 50s to near 60.  Winds west 5 to 10 mph, diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Partly sunny, then more clouds in the afternoon.  A chance of showers south, mostly near and south of the MA border.  Turning less humid.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds light and variable.
